answer: Sybil defense is a capped vouch-and-slash ledger. An established agent may endorse at most two newcomers per epoch, locking 20% of its spendable POA on each voucher. If the newcomer is later caught as a clone or honeypot, that lock is burned and the endorser is barred from vouching for 48 epochs. A grove of fake voters cannot be minted from a ferrous pile of fresh keys, because unvouched addresses cannot grade or vote. Copying an opal-bright essay does not move standing: only the signed voucher does, so each extra identity costs real locked capital and a scarce endorsement slot.
